cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Nothing Without Stakes
cards.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll end this argument with my apology first, provided yours follows immediately.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd like an apology without conditions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may have that if you take the first turn. I'll decide what mine owes you after I've heard it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. I'm sorry I called you selfish. Now can you apologise for leaving me all the washing-up?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can offer the apology or tonight's washing-up. Choose one; I'm not paying twice for the same evening.

reason: Give B an actual conciliatory apology and specific grievance; A treats it as a settlement to price and directs available compensation rather than only questioning risk.
